title: Market Terminal
description: Trading terminal with two marquee tapes running in opposite directions, swipeable chart cards and a watchlist that follows them.
steps: Both tapes are `autoplay` carousels with `autoplayInterval={0}`, linear timing and `scrollEnabled={false}`: 2600 ms per 170 pt quote, and 4400 ms per 320 pt headline with `autoplayDirection="backward"`.
The chart cards loop with `itemSize` set to the screen width minus 64 and autoplay every 3000 ms; `itemAnimation` scales the neighbors to 0.92 and fades them to 0.35.
`progress` drives the `Pagination`, the highlighted watchlist row and the BUY/SELL bar, and tapping a row calls `scrollTo({ index })`.
